description: This is a C# source file defining the `MasterRepository` class, which provides data access methods for various master/reference tables such as UOM, reporting programs, control devices, equations, and status codes within the Data Asset Backend system. It includes methods for creating, retrieving, updating, and querying these entities from a PostgreSQL database, using parameterized SQL commands and dependency injection of a connection factory and logger.

classes.name: MasterRepository
classes.description: A repository class encapsulating data access operations for master/reference entities within the system.

methods.name: CreateUomAsync
methods.description: Creates a new UOM master record in the database and returns the created DTO.

methods.name: GetUomByIdAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a UOM master record by its ID if not marked as deleted.

methods.name: UpdateUomAsync
methods.description: Updates an existing UOM master record identified by ID.

methods.name: QueryUomsAsync
methods.description: Queries a list of UOM records based on request parameters, with optional active-only filter.

methods.name: CreateReportingProgramAsync
methods.description: Creates a new reporting program master record.

methods.name: GetReportingProgramByIdAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a reporting program master record by ID.

methods.name: UpdateReportingProgramAsync
methods.description: Updates an existing reporting program master record.

methods.name: QueryReportingProgramsAsync
methods.description: Queries a list of reporting program records based on request parameters.

methods.name: CreateControlDeviceAsync
methods.description: Creates a new control device master record.

methods.name: GetControlDeviceByIdAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a control device record by ID.

methods.name: UpdateControlDeviceAsync
methods.description: Updates an existing control device record.

methods.name: QueryControlDevicesAsync
methods.description: Queries control device records, with optional site filter and active-only filter.

methods.name: CreateEquationAsync
methods.description: Creates a new equation master record.

methods.name: GetEquationByIdAsync
methods.description: Retrieves an equation master record by ID.

methods.name: UpdateEquationAsync
methods.description: Updates an existing equation master record.

methods.name: QueryEquationsAsync
methods.description: Queries a list of equation master records.

methods.name: CreateStatusCodeAsync
methods.description: Creates a new status code master record.

methods.name: GetStatusCodeByIdAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a status code master record by ID.

methods.name: UpdateStatusCodeAsync
methods.description: Updates an existing status code master record.

methods.name: QueryStatusCodesAsync
methods.description: Queries a list of status code master records.
